format: dashboard

---

```{r}
library(plotly)
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("titanic.csv") |> 
  drop_na(Age, Embarked) |>
  mutate(Survived = factor(Survived, labels = c("No", "Yes")),
         Pclass   = factor(Pclass))

survival_pct <- round((mean(df$Survived == "Yes") * 100), 0)
```


# Overview

## Column

### Row {height=25%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Passengers"
list(icon = "people", color = "lightgreen", value = nrow(df))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Survival Rate"
list(icon = "life-preserver", color = "lightblue", value = paste0(survival_pct, "%"))
```

### Row {height=75%}

```{r}
#| title: Survival by class
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Pclass, fill = Survived)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(y = "Proportion")
ggplotly(p)
```
